text:
dana.k: Heads-up: NorthHarbor signed off for a short case study. 20min interview + written quote follow-up. Need comms brief + legal release. :white_check_mark:
trent: great. which timezones? their engineering lead is CET but PM is US East.
lela_m: can do Fri 9am ET to hit both. prefer remote recording + headshot.
dana.k: OK locking Fri 2026-06-12 09:00 ET. can someone draft the pre-interview Qs and a short pull-quote prompt?
trent: on it. keeping it tight: 7 questions, 2 pull-quotes, one box for benchmark details. sending draft shortly.

Draft Qs (trent):
```
1) quick role + product context
2) which model and inference pattern did you move to Redwood? job/run id?
3) baseline vs current median latency numbers
4) config highlights (batching, kv cache, quantization)
5) cost delta or ops hours saved (if comfortable sharing)
6) business impact: user-facing metric or internal workflow change
7) any blockers or gotchas for other teams considering similar move
pull-quote prompts: "one-sentence impact" and "metric + signoff (name, title)"
```

lela_m: add ask for artifacts or attestation for any numeric benchmark. legal-bot: yep, we need either raw run logs/config or a signed attestation. 48-72h approval window on quote release.
legal-bot: also flag: no customer PII in screenshots; get written consent for any internal dashboards.
dana.k: localization: please provide a 1-line EU headline in German and a 1-line FR social caption.
trent: pinging NorthHarbor now with the Qs + release form link.
ops-bot: (automated) calendar invite created: Fri 2026-06-12 09:00 ET 90m buffer for setup. Recording disabled by default; enable only with customer consent.
dana.k: webinar idea: can NorthHarbor join a 15min launch panel (+Q&A) the week after publish? ask for an engineering speaker and 3-slide summary.
lela_m: routing: leads from the case page -> AE West queue (ae-west) and tag as "priority:enterprise". @sam.ae will that work?
sam.ae: yes please tag to ae-west and set lead scoring to 85 for immediate follow-up. i'll add nurture sequence to playbook.
trent: timeline check: interview Fri, quote release signed by Tue (72h), legal signoff Tue evening, design comps Wed, publish Thu next week, panel the following Tue. tight but doable.
legal-bot: we'll upload a compact quote release template to this thread after the call. please remind customer to sign within 3 business days.
dana.k: if we only get a customer attestation (no artifacts) we'll label any metrics as "customer-reported" with a brief methodology note.
trent: noted. adding a pinned checklist: interview asset, quote signed, attestation or artifacts, headshots, localization lines, design comps, routing tags, embargo date.
dana.k: setting embargo date to publish_date + 00:00 UTC on release day. please treat as confidential until publish.
lela_m: design-squad, once quote is signed can you produce hero asset + two social cards (16:9 and 1:1)?
design-squad: sure. need final quote text + headshot and one logo SVG. delivery target: 48h after signoff.
dana.k: thanks all. i'll post confirmations and NorthHarbor's replies here. :sparkles:
